_about: Offline seed list of flagged bank accounts, checked before any network lookup.
_source_policy: Every entry MUST carry a 'source'. Use 'demo_seed' ONLY for synthetic demo data. Real entries must name a verifiable public source (e.g. 'semakmule_top10' with the date observed). Never add a real account number without one - an invented report is a false accusation against a real account holder.
_adding_entries: account_number may contain spaces or dashes; matching is digits-only. report_count 0 means 'listed, count unknown'.

accounts.note: Reserved synthetic account for the live demo. Not a real reported account.
